Release notes

What is new in AviQuiz, newest first. Production dates are recorded when a release is deployed; preview releases are not yet live in production.

v0.2.0-alpha.1

Not yet deployed to production

This alpha expands seasonal practice across Colombia, adds Spanish, and brings optional account-based statistics to AviQuiz.

  • English and Colombian Spanish interfaces, with a language selector and localized labels, help, dialogs, and application messages.
  • Colombia-wide seasonal species data, with country, department, and processed-site quizzes. Species need available photo references to enter a photo quiz; photo coverage is still expanding.
  • Photo selection prefers the quarters in your seasonal window: January–March, April–June, July–September, and October–December. Windows spanning quarters can use either; other photo dates are used when matching photos are unavailable.
  • Optional signed-in statistics across devices, cumulative identification history and latest-result comparisons, browser-statistics consent, and import of older browser statistics. Guest quizzes remain available without an account.
  • A reusable command-line workflow for processing additional geographies, producing common seasonal data packages, and queuing photo metadata while reusing coverage already collected for other geographies.

v0.2.0-alpha.2

Deployed to production: November 28, 2026

This alpha update fixes inconsistent page navigation and carries forward the Colombia, Spanish, seasonal-photo, and account-statistics improvements planned for version 0.2.0.

  • Consistent header navigation across the quiz launcher, practice, statistics, trips, invitations, release notes, and photo-review pages. Statistics and the other main destinations are now available from every page; invitation access still follows account permissions.
  • English and Colombian Spanish interfaces, with a language selector and localized labels, help, dialogs, and application messages.
  • Colombia-wide seasonal species data, with country, department, and processed-site quizzes. Species need available photo references to enter a photo quiz; photo coverage is still expanding.
  • Photo selection prefers the quarters in your seasonal window: January–March, April–June, July–September, and October–December. Windows spanning quarters can use either; other photo dates are used when matching photos are unavailable.
  • Optional signed-in statistics across devices, cumulative identification history and latest-result comparisons, browser-statistics consent, and import of older browser statistics. Guest quizzes remain available without an account.
  • A reusable command-line workflow for processing additional geographies, producing common seasonal data packages, and queuing photo metadata while reusing coverage already collected for other geographies.

v0.1.0-alpha.1

Deployed to production: November 24, 2026

The first public alpha brings visual and audio bird-identification practice to aviquiz.org.

  • Photo and audio quizzes with site and family filters, mistake review, and separate visual/audio progress.
  • North Carolina seasonal geography quizzes, alongside the original Colombia itinerary and practice material.
  • Invitation-based accounts and guest quizzes open to everyone.
